szoveg_eredeti:
it's a skill issue to use frontier LLMs to detect objects or do vision 

instead, if you use LLMs as vision interns you can train a detector for $6 that runs at little cost. but your agent is a bad vision intern, it only knows old models that are proprietary and makes rookie mistakes 
so I built something for it, I basically distilled myself for you to use 🤝 I put my favorite models from keypoint detection to OCR as a tool for your agent to call and I also made an e2e object detection trainer (from labelling to VLM as a judge to training and eval) 

if you're interested in it and the results, my talk at AI Engineer World Fair is finally out, you can watch it 🙌🏻
I also shipped decision model support and updated VLMs (LFM3, Qwen3.6/8) I used in the project, find both the video and the github repository in comments 💬
YT: https://lnkd.in/dh7zb9yC 
GH repository: https://lnkd.in/dbDCMG3K
